title: BTC Intents - BOB
tagline: BOB Gateway: BTC intents bridge to enable native BTC swap via 1inch.
description:
We’re building native BTC → any asset swaps via 1inch Fusion+, powered by BOB Gateway the Bitcoin intents bridge.

What is BOB Gateway?
An intent-based BTC bridge that uses BOB (an OP Stack L2) as the execution and liquidity layer:
Trust-minimized via SPV light client
Scalable solver network for efficient pricing
Plug-and-play SDK/API for integration

Flow:
BTC → BOB → 1inch Fusion+ → Destination chain

How it works:
BOB Gateway uses SPV logic to verify Bitcoin transactions via a Bitcoin light client on BOB.
Settlement coordination happens on BOB through EVM smart contracts, while Bitcoin is used purely as the settlement layer.
Users send BTC to a Solver; once verified by the smart contract light client, the system triggers a call to 1inch contracts to execute the multi-chain swap.

⚡ What this unlocks
- Adds a decentralized BTC swap route on 1inch.
- Enables BTC → anychain routing via 1inch Fusion+.
- Users can execute a BTC → any ERC20/token swap in one Bitcoin signature.
- BOB Gateway abstracts all complexity: intent parsing, liquidity sourcing, execution, and routing.
how_its_made:
🔧 Tech Stack & Architecture
BOB Gateway is an intent-based BTC bridge that uses BOB, an OP Stack Layer 2, as the execution and liquidity layer.

Trustless settlement: Bitcoin transactions are verified via an SPV light client deployed on BOB.
Smart contract coordination: Once a BTC transfer is confirmed, EVM contracts on BOB resolve the user’s intent and route liquidity.
Solver network: Liquidity providers (solvers) register with the system and provide wrapped BTC on BOB in exchange for incoming BTC on Bitcoin.
1inch integration: After intent resolution, a smart contract on BOB triggers a call to 1inch Fusion+ to execute the destination swap, potentially across chains.

🔁 End-to-End Flow
BTC → BOB → 1inch Fusion+ → Destination chain

- User sends BTC to a Solver address with an OP_RETURN hash specifying their swap intent.
- SPV light client on BOB verifies the BTC tx after 3 confs.
- BOB smart contracts match the Solver and execute the swap via 1inch Fusion+.
- The user receives their target asset on any supported chain—no wallets or bridging needed.

About BOB and Why this works
BOB Gateway bridges two previously disconnected ecosystems—Bitcoin and EVM—by combining Bitcoin’s native liquidity with the programmability and composability of Ethereum.
BOB is the ideal execution layer for Bitcoin intents: low-cost, trust-minimized, and secured by BTC via Babylon. It is a Hybrid ZK Rollup, combining the strengths of both ZK and optimistic rollups in a single architecture.

BOB’s proving system is the most efficient in production today:
- ZK rollup speed with fast, on-demand finality
- Optimistic rollup efficiency and low costs, enabling open participation
- BTC Security via Babylon

This makes BOB the optimal environment to resolve Bitcoin intents—fast, secure, and universally composable across DeFi.
